notes: The New Fillmore (May 1986 to December 1987 and November 1989 to May 1990, 27 issues), the Fillmore and Pacific Heights monthly, every issue the Internet Archive collection sanfrancisconewspapers holds with an OCR layer. Source text is each item's hOCR search text; leaves from its hOCR page index. Citations give the leaf only: the Archive's page-number guesses are wrong for this title. Read by hand, with no reader pass; extra.candidate is the row key in /mnt/project-files/mission-papers/decisions_fillmore.py. extra.number_as_printed keeps a street number the paper printed differently from the parcel's page (the Grant Mansion, 2200 Broadway, on the Sacred Heart parcel at 2222). extra.record_date is the issue year for facts older than the paper. Most of the batch is Anne Bloomfield's monthly 'Great Old Houses' column, an architectural historian's account of one house an issue from contracts, water records and directories.

coverage.remaining: Nothing in this title: every issue with an OCR layer was read. The collection record and one item without hOCR were not.
coverage.note: 27 issues; 3,409 numbered-address mentions on EAS streets (ocr_mentions.py --rescue). The filter kept 188 windows, merged into 152 passages, all read by hand; the 'Great Old Houses' columns, which the address filter mostly misses, were pulled by title and by street number and read whole. 41 findings written, each quote found again in the issue's text. 33 resolved and 8 held: 7 shop and gallery openings on parcels with no page, and the Alta Plaza Apartments at 2500 Steiner, whose parcel has no roll row for seed-list to build a page from. 30 published on 26 pages (8 seeded), 3 declined because the page already carried the fact in more detail (Temple Sherith Israel twice, the Grant Mansion's 1948 sale). Not carried at all, the pages having them already: 2115 Bush and 2503 Clay (The Real Estate Associates), 2100 Vallejo, 2222 Broadway and 2622 Jackson. Seeding took up two held Building and Engineering News facts, read against the page images: the 1918 roof permit at 2104 Broadway and the 1916 garage at 1900 Webster, whose cost the OCR had as $3,950 and the page prints as $400. Three conflicts with dates already on pages are stated on the pages (Stanyan House, Grant Mansion, 2421 Pierce).
